He can teach you more about ranged combat than anybody else I can think of.|[[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Mikdanyell Guh'rantt]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MT" />}}
'''Purvis Arrison''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Don't fool yourself, we are at war. The Tusken Raiders are ready to take this city, and I won't let that happen. I won't let you let that happen either.|Purvis Arrison, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TRiME" />}}
Purvis Arrison was a skilled soldier who served during two decades in the [[Tatooine militia|Mos Eisley Militia]] as a [[Sniper/Legends|marksman]].<ref name="SWG:MT" /> By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Purvis Arrison was a veteran who still resided in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]],<ref name="SWG:TRiME" /> along with his brother [[Ellis Arrison|Ellis]].<ref name="SWG:OM1">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Officer|Officer Mission 1|Tatooine}}</ref> Purvis sill worked in Mos Eisley, under the orders of [[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Mikdanyell Guh'rantt]]. Arrison was very concerned about [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] gathering in [[Junktown]], a small [[City/Legends|village]] just outside of Mos Eisley.<ref name="SWG:TRiME" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he managed to get an individual to deal with the problem. While affiliated with [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's criminal organization]], the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] acted on behalf of the Mayor Mikdanyell Guh'rantt.<ref name="SWG:TRiME" /> The spacer eliminated a number of Tusken Raiders in Junktown, preventing them to raid Mos Eisley and making Purvis Arrison very satisfied.<ref name="SWG:TI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Tusken Infestation|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Purvis Arrison was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TRiME" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Purvis Arrison was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 17 Notes for 26 May 2005|Publish 17]]," on [[May 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> He used to be a specialized trainer providing quests to the beginner players who had chosen a "[[W:c:swg:Marksman|marksman]]" career.<ref name="SWG:MT" /> The "marksman" profession was later removed from the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]],<ref name="SWG:2005" /> and Purvis Arrison's quests were widely revamped to be available for every new players.<ref name="SWG:TRiME" />
